comment_text: The main qualification is to be the dumbest person in the room! Who needs intelligence to be the director of intelligence?!

Pulte's appointment to DNI is shades of Richard Nixon. FISA is set to expire in a couple of days and the Senate seems unconcerned. It's bad enough to have the FBI and the DOJ weaponized against Trump's enemies, but now throw in the CIA. We've been lucky that they have been bumbling clods, but they will get more efficient over time. Scary thought.
